messages:
maya: quick share — did a focused bring-up for the new narrowband-12B model quantized to int4 on the chat streaming workload.
ciara-bot: perf summary uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-results/narrowband/1719001234/summary.csv :white_check_mark:
ravi: top-line econ: int4 cut token cost ~2.7x vs int8; throughput up ~1.9x. quality delta: avg F1 drop ~0.45% on our core QA slice.
liam: thanks. product question: any visible regressions on the memory / context-sensitive flows (the ones that drive retention)?
jordana: looked at slices — QA drift concentrated on multi-turn context trivia and long-step code completions. hallucination rate up for the "chain-reasoning" slice from 1.4%->2.8%.
olivia: infra notes: int4 KV cache smaller, so p95 latency improved ~12ms, p99 unchanged (still noisy during GC windows). GPU utilization jumps less spiky.
maya: short log dump:
```
bench: narrowband-12B | mode=int4 | seq=512 | rps=120 | p50=45ms | p95=78ms | p99=210ms | tok_cost=$0.00032
bench: narrowband-12B | mode=int8 | seq=512 | rps=65  | p50=68ms | p95=90ms | p99=205ms | tok_cost=$0.00086
eval: core-qa | int8 -> EM=85.3 | int4 -> EM=84.9 (+/-0.4)
eval: chain-reasoning | int8 -> pass=92.6 | int4 -> pass=89.1 (regression)
```
maya: that PR was a quick quant pass with 4-bit groupwise QAT + per-channel scaling; no model surgery.
ravi: unit-econ view: if we route low-sensitivity queries (kb lookup, short chitchat) to int4 default, we can save ~40% of monthly hosted cost while keeping critical paths on int8.
liam: can we define "low-sensitivity" concretely for GTN/product? we need a simple rule for routing that GTN can use (and explain in docs).
jordana: suggest these signal heuristics for routing: 1) prompt length < 120 tokens AND 2) no system prompt with `requires-accuracy:true` flag AND 3) intent != code-generation. Also include a random 5% safety sample into int8 to monitor drift.
olivia: ops: implement route flags: `route_mode=int4_candidate` + canary_percent. Add auto-fallback gate: if rolling 5m EM delta > 0.8% or p99 latency > 220ms, flip traffic back to int8.
maya: proposed short recommendation for GTN & Product:
- Start canary: 5% of traffic selected by the heuristics above.
- Success gates for expanding: 7d rolling EM delta < 0.5% AND hallucination rate delta < 0.8% AND p99 latency <= 220ms.
- If any gate fails, automatic rollback to int8 and open a triage ticket.
ravi: agree. economics addendum: with 5->50% rollout ramp, expected monthly spend reduction on that service line: ~28% (conservative). put a billing alert at 10% delta to CI/CD finance channel.
liam: good. I'll draft the GTN note: short blurb + recommended customer-facing phrasing that avoids technical jargon. will share in #product-announce for review.
jordana: action items: (1) add evaluation slices for long-context chains (owner: jordana), (2) add 5% random safety sampling to int8 (owner: maya), (3) implement routing flags + rollback gates (owner: olivia), (4) finance alert (owner: ravi).
maya: ack, starting canary next Tues. will post a quick runbook and the rollout flag values here. :thumbsup:
liam: +1 — please include rollback playbook and PR link.
ciara-bot: scheduled job created: `narrowband-int4-canary-monitor` every 5m. logs -> #eng-ml-canary, metrics -> datadog/dashboard/nb-int4-canary
maya: thanks team — will follow up with the runbook and first-day metrics snapshot. :rocket:
